rs.intro: 150,000 ride-sharing bookings, straight from a raw export. Switch on each cleaning step: nothing gets deleted, every problem gets flagged so whoever uses the data can decide.
rs.step.nulos.why: The ride never happened (cancelled or no driver), so there is no fare, distance or rating. That is structural missingness (MNAR): not imputed.
rs.step.duplicados.why: 1,224 IDs appear more than once with completely different data: an ID generation bug. Flagged, not removed.
rs.step.outliers_iqr.why: Values beyond Tukey's fences (1.5 × IQR) in at least one measure: fare, distance, times or ratings.
rs.step.outliers_lof.why: Local Outlier Factor on the 93,000 completed rides (k = log n). Only 1 record scores above 1.5 and none above 2: the data is remarkably regular.
rs.cloud: 93,000 completed rides projected on their first three principal components (3,000-point sample). Drag to rotate.
rs.cloud2d: 93,000 completed rides on their first two principal components (3,000-point sample).
